cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Fifth concept. Adapted from the Arctic Goddess ingredient-grid format (FB 1091832579940707, 37 days running), rebuilt in Motilli's colours: heavy black condensed headline with lime marker-block highlights, ceramic bowls holding the actives, the jar centered and large below, and a lime ticker running edge to edge behind it. Their headline was THIS IS THE / FULL ARCTIC RESET, / IN ONE RITUAL. Ours drops the worn-out ritual framing and sells the formulation instead: IN ONE GUMMY. Three headline variations, identical layout. 4:5 at 1080x1350. CURRENT VERSION 2026-08-26: three bowls in a triangle with soluble fiber centered, gummy bowl removed entirely.

cards.title: OURS · three headlines, one layout  ·  ours

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: THE THREE BOWLS
cards.text:
Upper left: fresh chopped celery with a pour of green juice · CELERY JUICE
Upper right: fine pale yellow crystalline powder · APIGENIN
Lower centre: fine soft white powder · SOLUBLE FIBER

The reference runs a 2x2 grid because it has four things to show. We have three actives, so the fourth bowl came out and soluble fiber moved to the centre beneath the other two.

A triangle is the correct resting shape for three objects, and it also points the eye straight down into the jar, which a lopsided three-quarters grid would not.

The gummy bowl is gone entirely. It was showing and telling: the headline already says ONE GUMMY and the jar directly below is full of them. The grid's only job is the ingredients.

cards.title: REVISION LOG
cards.text:
2026-08-25 pass 1: headline read IN TWO GUMMIES, gummy bowl carried an IN ONE GUMMY label, and the top of the headline was clipped.

2026-08-25 pass 2: headline corrected to IN ONE GUMMY, gummy-bowl label removed, layout shifted down.

2026-08-26 pass 3 (current): gummy bowl removed entirely, three bowls in a triangle with soluble fiber centered.

CROP LESSON: the first pass split the 68px 3:4-to-4:5 crop evenly top and bottom, which ate into the headline. GPT Image 2 pushes content toward the top of the frame by default, so there is rarely spare room up there and almost always dead space below the product. Crop 4:5 from the BOTTOM only, and force a top margin in the prompt. Working instruction: leave a large band of completely empty background across the very top, headline starts roughly one eighth of the image height down, every element sits lower than you would default to, nothing cropped or touching any edge.

BOWL-COUNT LESSON: to hold an exact object count, state it three ways. EXACTLY THREE and no more than three, then the positions one by one, then an explicit line saying there is no fourth bowl and no bowl of gummies anywhere. All three renders came back correct on the first roll with that phrasing.

cards.title: ONE GUMMY VERSUS TWO GUMMIES
cards.text:
ONE GUMMY is the formulation claim: everything assembled in a single gummy, which the mechanism bible supports.

TWO GUMMIES is the dose: two before bed.

The creative makes the formulation claim. The body copy carries the dose. An earlier pass ran IN TWO GUMMIES on the headline, which muddled the two and read like arithmetic.

cards.title: TICKER CARRIES THE GUARANTEE, NOT A DISCOUNT
cards.text:
The reference runs 60% OFF SUMMER SALE repeating.

No verified live Motilli offer exists in the folder and inventing a percentage breaks Law 2. The 90-day money-back guarantee is canon, is real risk reversal, and fills the same strip.

It also keeps the creative evergreen, which a summer-sale ticker would not be.

IF THERE IS A LIVE OFFER, give me the exact terms and I will swap it in. It is a single re-render.

cards.title: PRODUCT TRUTH NOTE
cards.text:
The brief said 'low-soluble fiber.'

The correct product truth is a FINE SOLUBLE PREBIOTIC FIBER, and what makes it different is that it is LOW BULK: it feeds the butyrate producers without the coarse volume that leaves her more distended than when she started.

On-image it reads SOLUBLE FIBER. Worth keeping straight, because 'low-soluble' would describe the opposite kind of fiber and undercuts the mechanism.

cards.title: PRIMARY TEXT · all three
cards.text:
Everything a stalled gut needs, in one gummy.

A GLP-1 slows digestion down. That is the point, and it works. The trouble is the slowdown reaches all the way to your colon, and once it does, the fix has to happen in two places at once.

The first is the environment. Concentrated celery juice, standardized for a real dose of apigenin. Apigenin barely absorbs into your bloodstream, which in most supplements would be a flaw and here is the entire point, because it means it stays down in the colon where the problem is, calming the lining and shifting the balance back toward the bacteria that matter.

The second is the food. A fine soluble prebiotic fiber that feeds those bacteria specifically, without the coarse bulk that leaves you more distended than when you started.

Rebuild the place, then feed what grows there. Every product in your drawer did one, the other, or neither. Most of them also asked you to mix something, time something, or choke down a powder that tastes like a lawn.

Two gummies before bed with a full glass of water. Sixty in a bottle, so one bottle is a month. Green apple. Third-party tested, lab results posted. Not a laxative, so the first few days are quiet and the first normal, non-cramping movement usually lands around day five.

None of it touches your weight loss. Weight loss lives in the brain and the appetite. This lives in the colon. Two separate systems, so you rebuild one and stay on the other.

Ninety days to decide. Email inside ninety days and every dollar comes back, no return required.

cards.title: FRAME QA · all three, current version
cards.text:
Bowl count: PASS. Exactly three in every frame. No fourth bowl, no gummy bowl, no duplication.

Arrangement: PASS. Triangle, two upper and one centered below, soluble fiber in the centre position.

Labels: PASS. Exactly three, CELERY JUICE / APIGENIN / SOLUBLE FIBER, each centered under its own bowl.

Top margin: PASS. Clear empty background above the headline. Nothing clipped, nothing touching an edge.

Headline: PASS. Three lines, spelled exactly, GLP-1 hyphenated correctly, lime marker blocks behind lines 2 and 3, inset from both edges.

Jar: PASS. One jar, centered, fully visible, not touching the bottom edge, motilli wordmark and CELERY JUICE FIBER GUMMIES legible.

Ticker: PASS. Lime strip edge to edge behind the jar, 90-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE repeating, partly occluded by the jar exactly like the reference.

Background: PASS. Clean soft off-white, no yellow or golden cast.

No invented badges, prices, star ratings or percentages.

cards.title: AUDIT
cards.text:
Law 2: no invented study, percentage, doctor, review count, customer quote or discount. Day-five marker and 60-count are canon.

Law 9: all three headlines cleared lawgate. No em dashes, no negation-affirmation beats, no parallel stacks.

Two separate systems: present in the body copy.

Swap test: PASS. Apigenin staying in the colon, the rebuild-then-feed order, and the low-bulk fiber distinction are ours. The drawer teardown argues against powders and fiber tubs by mechanism.

Shelf life: evergreen. No season in the creative.

CLAIM RISK: lowest of the five concepts. No body imagery, no before and after, no timeline promise on the creative.

VERIFY BEFORE LAUNCH: the 90-day no-return-required guarantee wording against the live policy page, and confirm 60 count is still correct on the current pack.
